design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and functional. Designed for heavy daily use by sales professionals. Emphasizes data clarity, progressive disclosure, and high-contrast typography over decorative elements.

body.usage: Data tables, lead details, notes, generic UI text

spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-md (6px) max. Avoid overly rounded corners to maintain the Swiss rigid feel.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900/20 focus:outline-none
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-200 focus:outline-none
buttons.danger: bg-red-600 text-white font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors

inputs.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600/20 focus:border-blue-600 transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400

kanban.column: w-80 flex-shrink-0 bg-slate-50/50 border border-slate-200 rounded-md flex flex-col max-h-full
kanban.card: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md p-4 cursor-pointer hover:border-slate-300 hover:shadow-sm m-2 transition-all

tables.header: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 bg-slate-50/50 border-b border-slate-200 px-4 py-3

badges.new: bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-medium
badges.hot: bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-medium
badges.won: bg-green-50 text-green-700 border border-green-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-medium

timeline.dot: absolute -left-1.5 mt-1.5 h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-blue-600 ring-4 ring-white

interactions_and_motion.philosophy: Fast, strictly functional, no gratuitous animation.
interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must darken their border or background slightly.
interactions_and_motion.focus_states: High contrast ring focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600/20 focus:outline-none.

icons_library.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Excellent for dense dashboards.

image_urls.description: Professional audio equipment, used as a subtle background or hero image for the login/register screens.
Modern office sales team, used in settings or onboarding flows.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA contrast ratios. Avoid light gray text on white backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='kanban-card-123').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI primarily using raw Tailwind CSS combined with heavily customized Shadcn components (for logic) to match the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' rigid design system.
Ensure the Dashboard uses the 'Control Room' grid strategy. All widgets must align perfectly with no jagged bottoms.
For the Kanban board, implement a horizontally scrollable container with fixed-width columns. Cards should have hover states with slight lifts.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for all primary headings and metrics, and Satoshi for data-heavy body text.
Inject the provided image URLs strictly into the Login page and any promotional/onboarding banners.
Add data-testid attributes to all form elements, CTA buttons, and interactive cards to ensure testability.
Keep spacing dense but structured. Apply `p-6` or `p-8` for outer container boundaries, but tighten inner spacing for data tables and list items.
Avoid using purely transparent header backgrounds. Use solid white or a subtle backdrop blur with a 1px border.
All components should be written in .js files as specified.
